newsitem.title: USA: Basin Exploration 1996 proved reserves up.
newsitem.headline: Basin Exploration 1996 proved reserves up.

text.p: Basin Exploration Inc said Wednesday that its proved reserves as of December 31, 1996 totaled 77 billion cubic feet equivalent.
The reserves were comprised of 7.9 million barrels of oil and natural gas liquids and 30 bcf of natural gas. The pre-tax value of the reserves at the end of 1996 was $83.7 million, Basin said.

During 1996, the company sold its D-J Basin properties, which were attributed proved reserves at December 31, 1995 of 144 billion cubic feet equivalent. On a pro forma basis, Basin's estimated reserve quantities at December 31, 1996 were 23 percent above prior year levels.
